messages.subject: Bayes modal estimation in 4PL
parts:
Dear Dr. Philip:

I just wanted to ask you if the bayes modal estimation in mirt also employs transformation on the discrimination parameter just like in Mislevy's approach. Is the estimation procedures in mirt for BME the same with BILOG? Thank you.

messages.subject: Re: Bayes modal estimation in 4PL

Phil
